title: ReadinessClosureState
description: Machine-readable readiness-closure ledger. Defines (a) the per-blocker ReadinessClosureRecord shape (one record per blocked readiness invariant, e.g. R4/R7/R8) and (b) the per-state required-evidence / transition contracts (stateContracts + record-level if-then constraints). Contract SSOT: docs/design/readiness_closure_protocol.md. Enforcement: tools/readiness_closure_check.nim. Evaluation identities follow the frozen formulas in docs/design/phasec_boundaries.md:139-144: EvaluationInputIdentity = H(EvidenceDigest || PolicyDigest || EvaluatorArtifactDigest || SchemaDigest || ExecutionContractDigest); DecisionIdentity = H(EvaluationInputIdentity || Verdict || Outcome). Absent composite terms are marked toBeComputedAt and are never replaced with a fabricated digest.

RecordStatus.description: Lifecycle status of the closure track. 'active' = being tracked; 'closed' = the record is retired (typically alongside a CLOSED currentState or an explicit archival decision).

ref.description: Repo-relative path of the ADR/document that ratifies the semantic decision, optionally with a :line anchor, e.g. docs/adr/0016-r4-promotion-eligibility.md.

title.description: Short title of the ratified decision.

decisionId.description: decisionId of a PRIOR independent evaluation decision artifact (HISTORICAL reference only, e.g. data/readiness/decision.independent.*.json). Never the canonical evaluationIdentity.

note.description: Free-text note about that historical evaluation.

toBeComputedAt.description: Marker for an absent/not-yet-computable term: what must be established before this term can be computed. A term marked toBeComputedAt must NEVER be replaced by a fabricated digest (ADR-0015 F2; AGENTS.md 0.9 theater prohibition).

DigestTerm.description: One composite identity term. Either a computed 64-hex digest or an explicit toBeComputedAt marker. The frozen formulas are docs/design/phasec_boundaries.md:139-144.

computed.description: true only when evaluationInputIdentity has been derived from all five input terms via the frozen formula (phasec_boundaries.md:139-141). False for any pending record.

evaluationInputIdentity.description: H(EvidenceDigest || PolicyDigest || EvaluatorArtifactDigest || SchemaDigest || ExecutionContractDigest) — no verdict (phasec_boundaries.md:139-141).

decisionIdentity.description: H(EvaluationInputIdentity || Verdict || Outcome) (phasec_boundaries.md:143-144). Never fabricated; toBeComputedAt until the evaluation input identity exists.

stateContracts.description: Per-state required-evidence / transition contracts. The checker (tools/readiness_closure_check.nim) enforces these; the schema carries them as structured annotations mirrored by the if/then constraints in the ReadinessClosureRecord definition.

OBSERVED.transition: The blocker invariant is observed: an evidence manifest digest is recorded. No ratification or revision required yet. Next state: CLASSIFIED.

requiredEvidence: blockerClass present and one of the BlockerClass enum values
CLASSIFIED.transition: The observed evidence is classified into exactly one blocker class. Next: SEMANTICALLY_RATIFIED or a BLOCKED_* state.

requiredEvidence: ratification[] non-empty: at least one ADR/doc reference (ref+title)
SEMANTICALLY_RATIFIED.transition: To ENTER this state, ratification reference(s) must be present: the semantic decision behind the blocker is ratified. Next: CONTRACT_REVISION_RATIFIED (a contractRevision sha).

CONTRACT_REVISION_RATIFIED.transition: To ENTER this state, a contractRevision sha must be present. The ratified decision has a concrete contract text revision. Next: IMPLEMENTED (an implementationRevision sha).

IMPLEMENTED.transition: To ENTER this state, an implementationRevision sha must be present. Next: INDEPENDENTLY_REEVALUATED (a fresh independent evaluation of the new evidence) then CLOSED.

requiredEvidence: priorEvaluations[] contains at least one independent re-evaluation entry (decisionId + evidenceManifestDigest + verdict)
INDEPENDENTLY_REEVALUATED.transition: A fresh independent evaluation has been run against the current evidence snapshot and the resulting decision artifact reference is appended to priorEvaluations. Next: CLOSED.

CLOSED.transition: To ENTER CLOSED, ALL of {ratification, contractRevision, implementationRevision, evaluationIdentity.computed} must be present. CHECKER RULE: a record whose currentState is CLOSED but lacks any required evidence is INVALID (fail-closed; mirrors the if/then constraint).

BLOCKED_BY_DECISION.transition: The record is suspended pending a specific decision (e.g. a ratified revision step). pendingDecision describes exactly which decision is awaited. Closure evidence may exist but is not yet complete.

BLOCKED_BY_RESEARCH.transition: The record is suspended pending a research workstream. researchReference cites the research charter / blocker. A research result re-enters the product path only after deliberate adoption, a NEW evidence snapshot, and a NEW evaluator run.

requiredEvidence: pendingDecision or researchReference describing the blocking implementation dependency
BLOCKED_BY_IMPLEMENTATION.transition: The record is suspended on an implementation dependency. As of schema v1 no record instantiates this state; the checker expects a traceable annotation identifying the blocking dependency.

observedEvidenceDigest.description: The evidence manifest digest observed for this invariant (string) or null while no observation exists.

ratification.description: Ratified ADR/doc references backing the semantic decision. At least one item is required in states SEMANTICALLY_RATIFIED and beyond.

contractRevision.description: 40-hex commit sha of the ratified contract text, or null while pending.

implementationRevision.description: 40-hex commit sha of the implementation, or null while pending.

priorEvaluations.description: HISTORICAL evaluation references only (decision artifacts on record). Explicitly NOT the canonical evaluationIdentity.

pendingDecision.description: Present (and non-empty) iff the currentState is BLOCKED_BY_DECISION — the specific decision awaited.

researchReference.description: Present (and non-empty) iff the currentState is BLOCKED_BY_RESEARCH — the research charter / blocker reference.

predecessor.description: Invariant id of the prior closure record in a chain (e.g. 'R3'), or null for the head record.
